cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(MonakaBridgeInputProtocol LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tools/verify_mvip.py" COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
add_subdirectory(../third_party/mvip/cpp mvip)
add_library(monaka_capability_normalizer src/normalizer.cpp)
target_compile_features(monaka_capability_normalizer PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(monaka_capability_normalizer PUBLIC include)
target_link_libraries(monaka_capability_normalizer PUBLIC MonakaVRInputProtocol::Capabilities)
add_library(MonakaBridgeInputProtocol::Capabilities ALIAS monaka_capability_normalizer)
add_executable(mbip_capabilities_runner tests/normalizer_runner.cpp)
target_include_directories(mbip_capabilities_runner PRIVATE ../third_party/mvip/cpp/third_party)
target_link_libraries(mbip_capabilities_runner PRIVATE monaka_capability_normalizer)
add_executable(mvip_boundary_encoder ../third_party/mvip/cpp/tests/runner_v2.cpp)
target_link_libraries(mvip_boundary_encoder PRIVATE MonakaVRInputProtocol::Codec)
if(MSVC)
 target_compile_options(monaka_capability_normalizer PRIVATE /W4 /utf-8)
endif()
